title: The Eriksson Programme: Machine-Checked Lattice Yang-Mills Foundations and Open Frontier in Lean 4 (Archival Release)
description: Pinned Lean 4 (v4.29.0-rc6) / Mathlib archival release of the Yang-Mills formalization programme (YangMillsCore verified green in CI with zero sorry and zero project axioms beyond [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]), together with 28 compiled mathematical-physics manuscripts, verification ledgers, and an explicit handoff map of open frontiers (hRpoly, physical SU(N) reflection positivity/transfer, and 4D continuum/OS-Wightman reconstruction). No 4D continuum mass gap or Clay Millennium Prize solution is claimed.
